title: Auto envvar applied to empty list
detail: For an empty list envvar, not envvar is True, so the auto_envvar_prefix logic incorrectly sets envvar to the auto prefix, leading to wrong help output.

title: Missing default for Content-Type header
detail: If the client is instantiated without a Content-Type header, self.headers["Content-Type"] raises a KeyError, causing a crash before the request is sent.

title: Incorrect stream filtering in _serve
detail: The list comprehension uses the loop variable `stream` from the outer `while` loop instead of iterating over the existing streams. As a result, it always keeps only the most recently accepted stream and discards all others, potentially leaking connections and causing resource exhaustion.
